name: Muryeong of Baekje
contribution: The 25th king of Baekje, one of the Three Kingdoms of Korea, reigning from 501 to 523.
legacy: It was the first time that a Japanese emperor publicly referred to Korean blood in the imperial line

checks.lead: Muryeong (461/462–523) was the 25th king of Baekje, one of the Three Kingdoms of Korea, reigning from 501 to 523. During his reign, Baekje remained allied with Silla against Goguryeo, and expanded its relationships with China and Japan. According to Samguk sagi, he was 8 cheok tall, kind and generous, whom people followed naturally.
